messages:
shreya: quick style nit on PR #842 — can we rename `ctx` -> `context` in router.py? ruff is flagging the naming and it's confusing in a few handlers. could someone take this? :eyes:

alex: I can do it. do we want the rename in the same PR or as a tiny follow-up commit?

jamie: separate commit preferred — makes blame and rollbacks easier. also run `pre-commit run --all-files` after changes.

linus: heads-up: there are references in tests too (tests/test_router.py) and a fixture called `ctx_fixture`. you'll need to update those. example diff: 
```
- def handler(ctx):
-     return ctx.user_id
+ def handler(context):
+     return context.user_id
```

ci-bot: CI report: ruff / pytest failed for PR #842 — https://ci.redwood/1750301234/checks/842 — ruff error: F821 undefined name 'context' in router.py:42 (so tests caught the mismatch).

alex: thanks, I'll push a small commit that renames usages in code + tests and run pre-commit. plan to keep it standalone: `style: rename ctx -> context (router.py + tests)`. aiming to push in ~15m.

shreya: yep, that commit message looks good. please don't bundle other refactors in the same commit.

alex: pushed to branch `pr/842-style-ctx-rename` — commit `a1b2c3d`. commands I ran: 
```
git mv router.py router.py && 
# (manual edits) 
pre-commit run --all-files
pytest tests/test_router.py::test_handler -q
```

ci-bot: build triggered for `pr/842-style-ctx-rename` — running ruff + pytest. :hourglass:

ci-bot: all checks passed ✅ — https://ci.redwood/1750301234/checks/842

jamie: LGTM :shipit:

shreya: approved, feel free to merge when green. :thumbsup:

alex: merged via squash, thanks everyone!
